title: Good job!
body: App works well, simple, easy and intuitive user interface. I like being able to view the tracker from the iOS mobile Home Screen which helps with compliance - seeing the days go by is motivating. A good future functionality upgrade would be to be able to view two goals at the same time, I.e cut junk food and walk more etc. otherwise good job.

title: I love Days Since!! 🤩
body:
The Days Since app helps me with my diet, - intermittent fasting. Keeping a streak on days, weeks, or months - spent on a certain weight.
Hopefully one day years on a certain weight! 😍
I use it to see how far into my cycle I am, for choosing the right fasting length according to my hormones. 

I use Days Since to keep a streak on stretching regularly. 
I use it to keep a streak for my husbands weight. 
And for sticking to our economic budget! 😃

Thank you, Days Since!!
